jobs.occupation: Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Oosterhout, Gelderland
jobs.description: Work as a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online in Oosterhout, Gelderland. Earn €18.83 gross per hour all-in and work 12-32 hours per week. Wat bieden wij? An all-in gross hourly wage of €18.83, including holiday allowance and applicable allowances. 25 vacation days based on full-time employment. Pension accrual. Travel allowance. A flexible position for 12 to 32 hours per week. The opportunity to submit your own availability. Shifts from Monday through Sunday. Morning, afternoon and evening shifts. Practical training with an experienced buddy. Employee discount through the Albert Heijn Bonus Card. Opportunities to develop within the role, for example by becoming a buddy for new drivers. An active job with plenty of variety and time on the road. Opportunities for long-term employment through Consolid. Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Oosterhout, Gelderland Your working day starts at the Albert Heijn Online location at Linie 11 in Oosterhout, Gelderland. Here, you collect the keys to your delivery van, check the route for your shift and get ready to head out. Once on the road, navigation guides you from one customer to the next. Your route can take you through Oosterhout and other places in the surrounding area, so every shift can look a little different. When you arrive at an address, you select the correct grocery order from the van and check it using a handheld scanner. You then carry the crates to the customer's front door and make sure the order is handed over correctly. Customer contact is an important part of the job. You greet customers in a friendly way, help with questions when necessary and process payments if required. Empty crates and returnable packaging can also be collected before you continue your route. After completing the delivery, you get back behind the wheel and head to the next address. Although driving is a major part of the role, you will not spend your entire shift sitting down. You regularly get in and out of tvan, walk to customers' doors and lift grocery crates. This makes the job a good combination of driving, physical activity and customer service. Once you have completed your final delivery, you return to Linie 11. You finish your route, return the necessary equipment and leave the delivery van ready for the next shift. Do I need experience as a delivery driver? No. Previous experience as a delivery driver or courier is not required. During your first working days, you will be trained by an experienced buddy. You will learn how to use the delivery van, handheld scanner and systems, as well as how to deliver orders and deal with different situations at the customer's door. Once you are familiar with the job, you can start driving your routes independently. Can I submit my own availability? Yes. You can let us know when you are available, and this will be taken into account when the schedule is created. You can work between 12 and 32 hours per week. For this position, you need to be available for at least two shifts per week and at least two Saturdays per month. What does a typical shift involve? You start at Linie 11, collect your van and check your route. You then drive to the customers scheduled for your shift. At each stop, you scan and deliver the groceries, help the customer when needed and collect empty crates. After your final delivery, you return to the location and complete your shift. Can I develop within this role? Yes. Once you have gained experience, there are opportunities to take on additional responsibilities. For example, you may become a buddy and help train new delivery drivers during their first working days. Their approach was clear: act quickly with quality at the center. With offices in Naaldwijk and Maasdijk, Transport People was known for its strong regional involvement in South Holland, particularly in the Westland, Rotterdam, and The Hague areas. They built a strong position by focusing on close relationships with clients and finding the right match with drivers and logistics professionals. Transport People stood out through a combination of specialization, a human approach, and dedicated guidance. As a market specialist in transport and logistics, they helped truck drivers and logistics professionals find suitable jobs for nearly 10 years. Like Logistic Force, Transport People always focused on sustainable matches, with job satisfaction as a key priority. Naaldwijk What did Transport People do exactly? Until the acquisition by Logistic Force in October 2025, Transport People mainly focused on recruiting and placing professionals in transport and logistics, including: - Truck drivers (C/CE) mainly in sectors such as fresh produce (AGF), flowers and plants, waste management and recycling, distribution, air freight and container transport; - Logistics employees, order pickers, shunters/terminal tractor drivers and forklift and reach truck drivers ; - Clients in transport, logistics, production and supply chain . With strong knowledge of the sector's dynamics, Transport People had long focused on sustainable cooperation.

jobs.occupation: Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Almere
jobs.description: Wat bieden wij? An all-in gross hourly wage of €18.83, including holiday allowance and applicable allowances. 25 vacation days based on full-time employment. Pension accrual. Travel allowance. A flexible position for 12 to 32 hours per week. The opportunity to submit your own availability. Shifts from Monday through Sunday. Morning, afternoon and evening shifts. Practical training with an experienced buddy. Employee discount through the Albert Heijn Bonus Card. Opportunities to develop and become a buddy for new colleagues. A varied role combining driving, customer service and physical activity. Opportunities for long-term employment through Consolid. Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Almere As a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online in Almere, you take online grocery orders on the final part of their journey: from the delivery location to the customer's front door. At the beginning of your shift, you collect the keys to your delivery van and check the route prepared for you. Once you are ready, you head out to your first address. Navigation guides you between customers in Almere and the surrounding area. At each stop, you select the correct order from the van and check it with a handheld scanner. You then carry the grocery crates to the customer's door. You make sure every order is handed over in a friendly and professional way. If a payment needs to be processed, you take care of it. Empty crates and returnable packaging can also be collected before you leave. Then it is time for your next delivery. You will spend plenty of time behind the wheel, but this is not a job where you sit down all day. Getting in and out of the van, walking to customers' doors and carrying grocery crates are all part of a normal shift. Once your final order has been delivered, you return to the Almere location. You complete the route, return your equipment and leave the van ready for its next shift. Do I need previous experience? No. Previous experience as acourier or delivery driver is not required. An experienced buddy will train you during your first working days. You will learn how to use the van, scanner and delivery systems and how to handle different situations at the customer's door. How flexible are the working hours? You can submit your availability and work between 12 and 32 hours per week. Deliveries take place from Monday through Sunday, with shifts available at different times of the day. You need to be available for at least two shifts per week and at least two Saturdays per month. Is this an active job? Yes. Driving is only one part of the role. Throughout your shift, you regularly get in and out of the van and carry grocery crates to customers. You should therefore be comfortable with physical activity while working. Are there opportunities to develop? Yes. After gaining experience, you may have the opportunity to become a buddy. In this role, you help new delivery drivers during their first working days. Functie eisen Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Almere You are at least 18 years old. You have a valid category B driving licence. You speak Dutch and/or English. You are available for at least two shifts per week. You can work at least two Saturdays per month. You are friendly and helpful towards customers. You are comfortable working independently. You drive safely and responsibly. You are physically able to lift and carry grocery crates. Ready for a job that keeps you moving? Apply through Consolid and start as a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online in Almere. Questions about the position? Contact Seyyed by phone or WhatsApp at 06 83110102, or email s.parwiz@consolid.nl.
